eps.d: When two detectorists stumble upon a hoard of treasure worth millions, they know that selling it could solve all their financial worries.
As DS Doyle starts asking Martin awkward questions, Rocky becomes increasingly volatile. Meanwhile, Laura discovers that her and Ashley's wedding fund has vanished from their account.
There's relief as Laura is released, but who was behind her abduction? Salvation seems to arrive for the desperate Martin in the guise of suave antique collector Denys Elland.
Anne, desperate to bring Josh home, hatches a bold plan to save her family.
